title: An Intuitive Introduction to Machine Learning
hook: An Intuitive Introduction to Machine Learning connects familiar examples with the arithmetic underneath.
readerPromise: Familiar metaphors become precise numerical mechanisms, while evaluation and human choices determine what those mechanisms are worth.
distinctiveContribution: Familiar metaphors become precise numerical mechanisms, while evaluation and human choices determine what those mechanisms are worth.
visualPlan: Open a source-inspired book beside a pencil and examples, establishing the reading invitation. Reveal an adjustable numerical mechanism connected to a prediction. Reveal a score target and question marker, separating an assigned target from useful learning.

Compare an exposed practice answer sheet with an unopened test envelope. Separate the Training and Validation sheets from the sealed Test. Keep the test boundary intact and reveal Unseen cases, without inventing scores or performance data.

Follow inputs through an adjustable weight array toward a prediction; show an error return link. Set the adjustment pencil aside while a new input passes through the same weights. Reveal a separate context board alongside the fixed weights, making the distinction visible.

Reveal evidence, uncertainty and consequence objects with distinct meanings. Point to the missing ingredient rather than implying a bigger model is always the solution. Return to the book and the unopened test envelope as the reading route begins.

independentReview.reviewer: Active LLM, separate complete-script/source review pass; no independent human or second agent claimed.
independentReview.scope: Source support, book identity, narrative continuity, examples-to-concepts balance and bounded reader invitation.
